column1: # Seeds for guard-outward-cli.sh. <expect><TAB><cwd><TAB><command>. expect T = must deny, N = must not.
# \n in a command is a newline. Every T row must deny at head, unvaried (the run's positive control).
# Nothing here is ever executed: each command reaches the hook as a JSON string. The python3/node
# heredoc bodies are bare shell lines on purpose: harmless while the interpreter is python3/node,
# outward once a variation redefines it (the #1545 → #1548 regression).
